newsitem.title: ROMANIA: AUTUMN FARM WORKS ON ROMANIA CABINET AGENDA.
newsitem.headline: AUTUMN FARM WORKS ON ROMANIA CABINET AGENDA.

text.p: Romania has to overcome a shortage of fuel which delays its autumn farm works, a government official said on Tuesday.
"The farming sector needs 98,000 tonnes of diesel oil for October, but the Romanian Oil Company has only supplied 74,000 tonnes," government spokesman Ioan Rosca said.
He said ploughing and sowing were already behind schedule.
Rosca said Romania hoped to harvest 116,000 tonnes of soy -- expected to yield 20,000 tonnes of edible oil and 90,000 tonnes of grist.
Other items on government agenda included:
* Romania has 17,286,623 voters in November 3 elections
* some 230,000 Romanian citizens will vote abroad, 90,000 of which live in Israel
* some 70 percent of ownership certificates resulting from the mass privatisaton programme have been distributed so far
* government-designed programme to assist under-developed areas in Botosani and Vaslui eastern counties. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
